tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 16.2 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Zustand (persist), TanStack Query, react-hook-form + zod
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI, sibling repo ../urgent-printers-backend (async SQLModel + PostgreSQL). Not driven through the browser — read app/api/v1/routes/customer/ and app/schemas/ for request/response contracts only.

brand.voice_persona: confident, warm, plain-spoken — a helpful teammate showing a customer around, not an ad

_notes._generated: Set up as part of the QA/docs/demo-video pipeline. See ../pipeline/README.md for the module map and ../.claude/commands/qa/*.md for the prompts that read this file.
_notes.brand: primary_color/accent_color are this app's live theme tokens (rootless :root 'roseGold' default — see app/globals.css and lib/themes.ts). oklch() renders fine in the Chromium engine Remotion uses.
_notes.field_style: White background / dark text matches the default storefront theme. If a demo is captured on a dark-themed variant, override this per-run rather than changing the default.
_notes.tts: voice_id is unfilled — pick a voice from the ElevenLabs dashboard before the first /qa:narrate-feature run. Free tier cannot use library voices over the API; a stock voice works for eleven_multilingual_v2.
_notes.llm: null routes every AI module to Claude, which needs no local infrastructure. See ../pipeline/README.md's 'AI models' section before changing this.
_notes.urls: Playwright's playwright.config.js boots dev_command at urls.staging with reuseExistingServer: true, so an already-running `npm run dev` is reused.
